note: Files this project has deleted. `npm run prune` removes them from an install that was updated by extracting an archive over the top, because tar adds and overwrites but never deletes. A leftover file still imports what it always imported, so the build fails on a module that was removed on purpose.

removed.reason: The three-column app shell replaced the per-section website chrome. These layouts each rendered SiteHeader and SiteFooter, which the shell now owns; leaving them in place gives two headers on twelve routes, or a build error once site-header.tsx is gone.
Superseded by city-canvas.tsx, which keeps one persistent map instead of rebuilding it on every filter change.

The maintenance scripts moved into scripts/ and their imports became relative to it — './lib/admin' resolves to scripts/lib/admin. A copy still sitting at the project root resolves that same import against the root, where there is no lib/ at all, and `next build` fails type checking on a file the app never runs. tsconfig includes **/*.ts, so a stray root script breaks the build even though nothing imports it. These are the root-level names an older install could be carrying, hyphenated and not.
